key_insight: LLMs lose diagnostic accuracy when they must gather information interactively rather than receive a complete case upfront, highlighting limitations in targeted questioning.
clinical_relevance: Diagnostic accuracy on curated cases may overstate readiness for clinical workflows that require iterative history taking, examination, and test selection.
method: Introduced Hx2Dx ARENA with 1,000 simulated clinical encounters based on NEJM cases.
Evaluated open- and closed-source LLMs under multiple configurations.
Compared interactive information gathering with static, full-case evaluation.
evidence_signal: Every evaluated model performed worse interactively than with the full case upfront, and more targeted questioning was associated with better diagnosis.
watch_item: Simulated encounters do not establish real-world clinical safety; hypothesis-driven information gathering remains a key implementation concern.
paper_title: Hx2Dx: From Anamnesis to Diagnosis - A Multimodal Arena for Conversational Clinical Reasoning in LLMs
